ei.title: Thomas Wiggins and His Musical Legacy
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Thomas Wiggins, also known as 'Blind Tom,' was a remarkable pianist and composer born in 1849 in Georgia, USA. Born blind and enslaved, he displayed extraordinary musical talent from an early age. Wiggins could reproduce complex melodies after hearing them only once, earning recognition as a prodigy. He was also known for his ability to mimic sounds from nature and the environment, such as birdsong and trains, incorporating them into his performances. Despite his disability and the harsh conditions of slavery, he was taken on tour by his enslaver, and his performances astonished audiences across the United States and Europe. Wiggins composed over 100 pieces, blending classical, folk, and popular influences. His most famous work, 'The Battle of Manassas,' vividly depicts the sounds of the Civil War. After emancipation, he continued to perform, but exploitation by his handlers continued. Despite this, Wiggins became one of the most celebrated musicians of the 19th century. He passed away in 1908, leaving behind a legacy of human potential in the face of adversity.

questions.passage: Thomas Wiggins, also known as 'Blind Tom,' was a remarkable pianist and composer born in 1849 in Georgia, USA. Born blind and enslaved, he displayed extraordinary musical talent from an early age. Wiggins could reproduce complex melodies after hearing them only once, earning recognition as a prodigy. He was also known for his ability to mimic sounds from nature and the environment, such as birdsong and trains, incorporating them into his performances. Despite his disability and the harsh conditions of slavery, he was taken on tour by his enslaver, and his performances astonished audiences across the United States and Europe. Wiggins composed over 100 pieces, blending classical, folk, and popular influences. His most famous work, 'The Battle of Manassas,' vividly depicts the sounds of the Civil War. After emancipation, he continued to perform, but exploitation by his handlers continued. Despite this, Wiggins became one of the most celebrated musicians of the 19th century. He passed away in 1908, leaving behind a legacy of human potential in the face of adversity.

② 역경과 착취에도 불구한 비범한 음악 유산 — 지문 전체 핵심(remarkable talent, 19th-century celebrated musician, legacy of human potential) ←정답
③ 유럽 청중의 역할 — 지문의 한 세부 사항에 불과
④ 고전 음악이 작풍에 미친 영향 — 지문에 없는 내용
det.tip: despite adversity + extraordinary legacy = 역설이 주제의 핵심

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 a legacy of human potential in the face of adversity가 함축하는 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 역경 앞 인간 잠재력의 유산 = 극한 상황에서도 업적을 남길 수 있음
det.analysis:
밑줄 표현 'a legacy of human potential in the face of adversity'는 장애를 가지고 노예로 태어나 착취당하면서도 19세기 최고 음악가 중 한 명이 된 위긴스의 삶 전체를 압축한 표현.
① 재앙 없이 잠재력 불가 → 지문의 내용과 정반대
② 역사적 기록과 유산 전달 → 지문에 없는 외부 해석
③ 억압이 클수록 예술 완성도 상승 → 지나치게 일반화된 외부 주장
④ 극한 역경·착취에도 탁월한 능력과 업적 남김 → 지문 전체 서사와 일치 ←정답
det.tip: in the face of adversity = 역경에도 불구하고. 위긴스의 삶 전체가 이 표현의 증거

ch: 인간은 재앙과 역경이 없으면 진정한 잠재력을 발휘할 수 없다.
역사적 기록이 없으면 음악가의 유산은 후대에 전해지지 않는다.
사회적 억압이 클수록 예술의 완성도는 높아지는 역설이 존재한다.
극한의 역경과 착취에서도 인간은 탁월한 능력과 업적을 남길 수 있다.
